Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production pixel art environment sprite atlas for an isometric top-down fantasy RPG called The Hollow.
Primary request: exactly 16 separate full objects, arranged on a precise 4 by 4 grid on a transparent 1024 by 1024 canvas. Each object fully contained within its own 256x256 cell with at least 20px transparent margin. No borders, grid lines, text or labels. Every object centered horizontally and sitting on the same relative ground baseline 226 pixels down within each cell. Consistent 3/4 top-down view, see tops and front, light from upper left. Very beautiful detailed handcrafted pixel art with crisp discrete pixels and a limited cohesive jewel and earth palette, warm storybook atmosphere, organic readable silhouettes. Individual detail clusters equivalent to 2-4 pixels at full image resolution. NO smooth painterly gradients or blurry outlines.
Row 1 left to right: 1 a broad emerald giftwillow tree, arched trunk and hanging golden fruit on long threads; 2 enormous pink blooming spring tree, dark twisting trunk and layered rose blossoms; 3 gold and burnt orange autumn oak tree with knotted roots; 4 blue-green snow-covered fir with layered white snow.
